analyst.text: New Orleans have lost by 51 to Golden State and by 34 at home to Brooklyn in their last two games. Afterwards Zion Williamson called it "unacceptable" and told teammates and coaches to "look in the mirror". Trey Murphy III is out with knee soreness. Memphis have lost five of six since a 6-0 start, most recently 123-118 in Denver, where Tuomas Iisalo was criticised for not calling a late timeout. The Pelicans could respond to Zion's challenge, but a team this demoralised still leans toward Memphis.
